redis_idempotency.settings.idempotencyPe: How long a request still running holds its Idempotency-Key, so a retry is refused instead of running twice: 10 (the built-in time) to 60 minutes. A request whose server stopped also holds its key this long.
redis_idempotency.settings.idempotencyRe: How long a request sent with an Idempotency-Key is remembered once it succeeded: a retry with the same key gets the first answer instead of running again. 24 (the built-in time) to 168 hours; longer suits apps that send queued changes after days offline.
redis_idempotency.settings.subtitle: How long the whole installation remembers requests sent with an Idempotency-Key; each time can only be made longer
